definitions.U: Exact raw compute interval intersections / (NPU count * wall window); IO waits are included in denominator
definitions.SLO: Uncensored admission cohort [start,end): completion-admission <=1.5*own_compute; numerator and denominator are recomputed
definitions.demand: Sum admitted-current-request V_disk/C over admission-to-completion, including IO stall; excludes extra cross-request L0 prefetch
definitions.bins: Half-open intervals; the last bin can be partial; no result is extrapolated
definitions.completeness: Completed metrics marker plus full raw requests/layers/blocks; absent/invalid cases never pass

asu_baseline.conclusion: An audited finite trajectory; a low early window alone does not establish long-lived low utilization.

once.conclusion: An audited finite trajectory; a low early window alone does not establish long-lived low utilization.
